Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to 1,423.2 million dollars, 0.5117 percent of the 278.1 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,639.9 million dollars. Bitget remained the largest intake at 874.6 million dollars, Binance took in 323.4 million dollars, and Gate took in 216.0 million dollars, while OKX posted a 79.6 million dollar outflow, the largest departure.
